description: This file defines a class 'JsonapiMaintenanceModeSubscriber' that subscribes to maintenance mode events in Drupal and handles JSON:API requests during maintenance, returning a JSON API formatted response with a 503 status and retry-after header.

classes.name: JsonapiMaintenanceModeSubscriber
classes.description: A Drupal event subscriber that handles maintenance mode requests for JSON:API, returning a JSON API formatted 503 response with retry headers during maintenance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes maintenance mode and config factory dependencies.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this class subscribes to, specifically the maintenance mode request event.

methods.name: onMaintenanceModeRequest
methods.description: Handles the maintenance mode request event, returning a JSON:API formatted 503 response with retry-after header if the request format is 'api_json'.
